About IQI

IQI Trusted Petfood Ingredients is a global supplier of high-quality ingredients to premium pet food producers. These ingredients are derived from natural byproducts of the food chain. IQI oversees the entire value chain and is recognized as a co-creator of trusted premium pet food ingredients. Partner driven, Exceptional, Rock solid and Exploring are the core values of IQI. It is part of the OSI group since 2023.

Our Finance team in Amersfoort is looking for an experienced Financial Controller (m/f/d).

What your job includes

- Manage monthly and year-end closing activities
- Prepare financial reports and statutory financial statements
- Coordinate external audits and ensure tax compliance
- Monitor accounting quality, reconciliations, and inventory valuation
- Lead and support two accounting team members

What we expect from you

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
- Several years of relevant experience in financial controlling and accounting
- Experience in taking the lead with financial statements, audits & tax compliance
- Solid knowledge of IFRS; US GAAP is a plus
- Experience in an international, trading, or distribution environment is preferred
- Fluency in Dutch and English
- Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills
- Proactive, hands-on, and able to work independently within an international environment

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Marketing Specialist
 

Location: Aartselaar, Antwerp, Belgium
 

About Harmony Auto Belgium
 

Harmony Auto Belgium is an authorised DENZA dealer in Belgium and part of 
China Harmony Auto Holding Limited, a Hong Kong-listed automotive retail group with extensive experience in premium automotive retail, aftersales services and new energy vehicle business development.
 

As we continue to expand the DENZA brand in Belgium, we are looking for a motivated 
Marketing Specialist to join our growing team and help build a premium customer experience from the ground up.
 

Key ResponsibilitiesMarketing & Brand Development
 
 

• Plan and execute marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness. 

• Manage the company's social media platforms (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, etc.). 

• Create and coordinate marketing content, including photos, videos, newsletters and promotional materials. 

• Support the organisation of showroom events, product launches, customer events and test drive activities. 

• Coordinate marketing materials with DENZA headquarters and external suppliers. 

• Conduct market research and competitor analysis. 

• Monitor marketing performance and prepare regular reports.  

Communication
 
 

• Support communication between the Belgian team and headquarters. 

• Assist with translation and localisation of marketing materials when required. 

• Coordinate with media, agencies and business partners.  

Administration & Operations Support
 
 

• Provide administrative support to the Sales and Management team. 

• Prepare presentations, reports and meeting materials. 

• Maintain marketing documents, customer databases and promotional materials. 

• Assist with customer enquiries and internal coordination. 

• Support other business operations when required in a fast-growing start-up environment. 

Requirements
 
 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Communication or a related field. 

• 1–3 years of experience in Marketing, Events, Communications or a similar role. 

• Excellent organisational and communication skills. 

• Experience with social media management and content creation. 

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Canva or Adobe Creative Suite is a plus. 

• Fluent in 
Dutch and English. 

• Chinese language skills are a strong advantage. 

• French is considered a plus. 

• Proactive, creative and willing to work in a dynamic start-up environment.

jobs.description:
About the Boerma Instituut

The Boerma Instituut was founded in 1980 by Theo and Jose Boerma and is currently led by Jacqueline Boerma, fourth generation of a family with more than 120 years of experience in floral design.

The school offers foundation courses, international programmes, workshops, masterclasses and the Master Florist programme (Meesterbinder). Our mission is to train students from all over the world to become professional florists and floral designers.

Position

As a Floral Design Instructor, you will teach classical and modern floral design, guide international students and represent the school abroad. The role includes teaching in the Netherlands as well as international travel.

Responsibilities

- Teach International Vocational, Advanced and Master Florist programmes, levels 1 to 3
- Teach hand-tied bouquet courses and floral courses for funerals, weddings and events
- Provide private lessons and group training
- Prepare lessons, order materials and create sample pieces
- Coach and mentor students
- Support competitions, events and open days
- Travel internationally to teach and demonstrate on behalf of the school

Requirements

- Master Florist Diploma (Meesterbinder) with transcript
- Average grade of 8 or international equivalent
- Transcript must be submitted
- Knowledge of the Golden Ratio, proportion, Fibonacci composition and asymmetrical floral design
- Teaching experience at Master Florist level is required
- Extensive portfolio of own work; the portfolio must be submitted before the interview
- Knowledge of colour theory and correct nomenclature of flowers, plants and materials
- Willingness to learn Dutch
- English is currently the working language
- Minimum of 10 years of professional floral design experience
- Minimum of 3 years of teaching or training experience
- Experience with international competitions and demonstrations
- Valid category B driving licence
- Strong artistic vision, technical skills, pedagogical skills and flexibility to travel internationally

Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Furthermore, do you have an affinity for technical work and various industries, and are you up for working on the most challenging projects in hard-to-reach locations, such as at height and in confined spaces? Then this position as Rope Access Technician/Supervisor at Sky-Access B.V. is exactly what you are looking for! Company is based in Roosendaal.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone:

• With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)
• Who enjoys being physically active in their work
• Who has an affinity for working safely, the various industries, and technology
• With a flexible and positive work attitude, a team player
• Who has technical insight and enjoys working with their hands
• With a technical background
• With the necessary capabilities and ambition to take responsibility for rope safety on the projects
• Who takes initiative, both solicited and unsolicited, and provides advice on IRATA-related knowledge, skills, and methodologies
• Who is willing to work occasionally at irregular times (weekends/nights)
• With a good command of English
• Who holds a B driving license
• With VCA-VOL certification (or willing to obtain it)

________________________________________

What do we offer you?
• Contract duration: Intention is a permanent contract. First year a fixed term contract of 12 months (will be changed into a permanent contract if skills, performance and work attitude are meeting company demands)
Trial period: 1 month
Salary range (gross/month): €3.500 – €4.000 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for the Small Metal Industry
Housing: Employer offers suitable housing for the first period (to help the foreign colleque) – for this a contribution of the costs are for the account of employee (cost indication: between € 500 and € 600)
• A varied and challenging job within an enthusiastic and close-knit team
• Ample opportunities for personal development (IRATA upgrades, courses, advancement to project manager, IRATA part-time roles)
• Working on unique and technically challenging projects, both nationally and internationally
• Support and guidance in your career and certification processes
• A no-nonsense company culture with a focus on safety and quality

Do you want to work as a chef in the Netherlands this summer?

Do you have a passion for cooking and do you want to further develop your culinary talent in an inspiring environment? Restaurant De Basiliek in Middelburg is looking for a chef to join our team for the months of June, July, August, and September.

What will you be doing?

You will work together in a team with other Spanish colleagues. From mise en place to preparing dishes during service.

Who are you?

- You have at least 1 year of experience in a professional kitchen and work independently
- You speak English
- You have an eye for detail and present dishes with care
- You love challenges
- You work neatly, are stress-resistant, and think in solutions
- You are flexible and a true team player

About us
De Basiliek is located in Middelburg, a historic city close to the sea. De Basiliek is a beloved spot in our city frequented by many locals as well as tourists. We offer a modern menu with a Spanish touch, where shared dining and the grill set us apart. Quality, taste, and experience are our top priorities. As a cook, you are an important part of this experience.

The employee is employed as a seasonal worker. The employment contract is for 6 weeks to 4 months, at least June, July, August, and September. A fixed working volume averaging 38 hours per week is agreed upon. Working hours may vary per week but are averaged over the duration of the employment contract. More hours may be worked in certain weeks as needed.

Salary: The minimum salary is €2,500 gross per month and depends on education and experience. Salary classification is in accordance with the 2025-2026 Hospitality CLA.

Accommodation is available. Costs amount to €650 including energy, Wi-Fi, etc. It concerns the 2nd floor of a house with shared use of:

• the kitchen
• the toilet
• the bathroom
• the balcony
The bedroom does not need to be shared.

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

Job description 
 As a CE truck driver, you will be responsible for delivering various types of materials throughout Belgium. Whether it’s express deliveries, pallet transport, or construction-related materials, you’ll encounter a wide variety of jobs. Every day is different, while still offering a familiar routine. What does your day look like? 
    
• You start your day between 5:00 and 8:00 a.m. at our site in Bornem with a cup of coffee and a vehicle check.
    
• You will deliver various goods throughout Belgium. Occasionally, you may cross the border, but you will always return home at the end of the day.
    
• The number of daily stops depends on the schedule. Sometimes you may have just 1 stop, while on other days you could have up to 10.
 What are we looking for? 
    
• You have a CE driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a CE truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.
 What can you expect from us? 
    
• A competitive salary.
    
• A great working atmosphere and the opportunity to drive modern, high-quality equipment.

Can you tick all the boxes above? Apply today and join our team!

 Requirements 

    
• You have a Category C driving licence and the required certificates.
    
• You have a valid ADR certificate.
    
• You are flexible, reliable, and customer-friendly.
    
• You are physically fit.
    
• You have experience as a Category C truck driver.
    
• You have good knowledge of the road network.
    
• You have a good command of Dutch or English due to safety requirements.

jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer (French-Dutch-English, Night Shifts), you are the first point of contact for customers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. You’ll work within a small, supportive team to ensure that stranded vehicles or trucks get back on the road quickly. You’ll communicate by phone and email with customers, partners, and technical service providers. Your dedication and attention to detail help resolve a wide range of customer questions and issues, contributing to seamless service delivery.

On a typical day, you’ll handle incoming calls and emails, gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, and provide technical support where possible. You’ll keep customers and stakeholders updated, monitor agreements, and ensure all contract-related matters are handled within agreed deadlines. You’ll work night shifts from Thursday to Saturday (8:00 am to 8:00 pm), which allows for variety in your schedule and challenges your multitasking skills.

Are you a strong communicator, resilient under pressure, and customer-focused? Do you want to join a multicultural team where learning and growth are central? Apply today and discover how you can make a real impact for people in need.

• Fluent in Dutch, French, and English; any additional language is a plus

• Degree in higher secondary education, associate degree, or (professional/academic) bachelor

• Strong communication skills over phone and email

• Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)

• Accurate, resilient under stress, and able to multitask

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• Customer- and results-oriented

• No specific experience necessary; motivation and eagerness to learn are essential

 Your key skills:
